item.title: Oracle E-Business Suite Pre-Authentication RCE Chain (CVE-2025-61882)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2025-61882 (Oracle Security Alert, out-of-band, October 2025). Status: Patched (Oracle out-of-band Security Alert, October 2025). Affects: Oracle E-Business Suite — Oracle Concurrent Processing product, BI Publisher Integration component (reached via the /OA_HTML/ web tier: configurator/UiServlet and ieshostedsurvey.jsp). Tags: oracle-ebs, oracle-concurrent-processing, bi-publisher-integration, pre-auth, rce, ssrf, crlf-injection, request-smuggling, path-traversal, auth-bypass, xslt, java, cisa-kev, ransomware, cl0p, watchtowr.
